prose: Bloomberg reports that Google is dealing with doubt among its own employees about Gemini 4. The article was paywalled, so this brief follows the headline and the Techmeme summary: some staff say the model scores well on benchmarks but struggles with certain real-world coding tasks, while Google disputes that description.
highlights: Benchmarks strong, some real-world coding weaker (per sources)
Basis: headline and Techmeme blurb, article paywalled
